slides.title: Why your Shopify store is ==slow==
slides.sub: 4 checks. Most owners skip the last one.

slides.title: A slow product page loses the sale ==before the price loads.==
slides.sub: Most of your shoppers are on a phone.

slides.title: Apps you ==don't use==
slides.body: Uninstalled apps can leave code in your theme. Remove the leftovers, not just the app.

slides.title: Photos at the **right size**
slides.body: Upload product photos close to the size your theme shows them. A 4,000px photo in a 600px slot is wasted load.

slides.title: Widgets and ==pixels==
slides.body: Chat widgets, pop-ups and tracking pixels each load on every page. Keep the ones that earn their place.

slides.title: A ==clean custom== Shopify theme
slides.body: Years of quick fixes pile up. A rebuilt theme loads only what your store uses.

slides.title: Comment ==SHOPIFY==
slides.body: We'll set up a free 20-minute call to look at your store with you.

slides.title: mobile app projects delivered
slides.body: NDA signed before we see anything.

slides.title: Type each order ==once==
slides.sub: Not 3 times. When your tools talk, nobody retypes an address.

slides.title: Every retyped order is a chance to ==ship to the wrong address.==
Order comes in on **WhatsApp**
slides.body: Someone types it into the courier portal, then Excel, then Tally for the invoice.

slides.title: One order, ==entered once==
slides.body: An API integration sends it from your store or form to the courier, your sheet and your accounts.

slides.title: Your tools, **as they are**
slides.body: Shopify, WooCommerce, courier portals, Google Sheets, Tally or Zoho. Your team keeps what it knows.

slides.title: Tracking that ==sends itself==
slides.body: Customers get the tracking link automatically. Fewer 'where is my order?' calls.

slides.title: Comment ==SYNC==
slides.body: We'll send a free cost and timeline estimate for connecting your tools.

slides.title: Start with ==6 screens==
slides.sub: Everything else waits for version 2. Privacy doesn't.

slides.title: 1 order, typed ~~3 times~~ ==once==
slides.sub: Connect the WMS, TMS, carrier portals and ERP you already use.
